title: Population-stationary Ds partitions can defeat every efficient-semimetric rule
statement: Under a nuisance-sign-symmetric law, a psi-threshold partition split by sign(s_lam) is exactly stationary with pairwise-coincident projected centroids and profiled-information-free cells; its coarsening has an exactly singular binned nuisance block. Population stationarity does not force a separating deployable rule.

proof_location.section: DS12. Population stationary geometry for profiled \(D_s\)
